name: Mayuzumi Asuma
source: A second-year at Saisei Academy, a member of the idol unit Galaxy Standard and the younger brother of [url=/c43075]Shizuma[/url]. Doesn't care about small things and is quite different from his older brother. Asuma is the one who mostly writes the lyrics for their songs.
translation: A second-year at Saisei Academy, a member of the idol unit Galaxy Standard and the younger brother of [url=/c43075]Shizuma[/url]. Doesn't care about small things and is quite different from his older brother. Asuma is the one who mostly writes the lyrics for their songs.
